name: r187
body:
https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/wiki/Migration-Guide#186--187
https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/milestone/100?closed=1

- Global
  - Remove code deprecated in r177. #34517 (@linbingquan, @Mugen87)
- AnimationUtils
  - Fix cubic spline additive reference sampling. #34860 (@gjija)
- Backend
  - Keep occlusion query results per camera. #35066 (@arodic, @claude)
- BatchedMesh
  - Clarify geometry compatibility requirements. #34675 (@MikeFernandez-Pro, @Mugen87)
  - Fix sort corruption. #34828 (@Mugen87)
  - Make shadows more node compatible. #34829 (@Mugen87)
  - Fix draw ranges after `setGeometrySize()`. #34983 (@MikeFernandez-Pro)
  - Fix memory leak of previous matrix data. #35272 (@Mugen87)
- Bindings
  - Avoid recreating initial texture bind groups. #34657 (@mrdoob)
  - Avoid cache key allocations in `_update()`. #35120 (@Snuble-bot, @Mugen87, @claude)
  - Avoid cache key collision with similar IDs. #35226 (@Mugen87)
- Box3
  - Use BatchedMesh bounds in precise mode. #34863 (@gjija)
- BufferAttribute
  - (Interleaved)BufferAttribute: Optimize normalized data access. #34992 (@zeux)
- BufferGeometry
  - Finalize tangents once per vertex. #34624 (@mrdoob)
- Color
  - Accept negative hues and decimal percentages in `setStyle()`. #34849 (@ewraj)
- ColorManagement
  - Fix order of color space conversion matrix. #34952 (@michaelcrosato, @claude)
- CompressedTexture
  - Default `mipmaps` to an empty array. #35081 (@arodic, @Mugen87, @claude)
- Core
  - Make `copy()` methods more robust. #34691 (@Mugen87)
  - Fix reversed depth function mapping. #35264 (@WilliamLiu-1997)
- Curves
  - Invalidate cached lengths when copying or deserializing. #35118 (@dewanshshekhar, @Mugen87)
- EdgesGeometry
  - Use a Map for edge lookups. #34805 (@sarojpahi)
- FramebufferTexture
  - Fix `source` copy. #34636 (@Mugen87)
- Geometries
  - Add missing delete. #34648 (@Mugen87)
- Inspector
  - Auto-render non-texture nodes in the Viewer and fix `toInspector()` registration. #35253 (@sunag)
- InterleavedBuffer
  - Fix clone() and toJSON() of views into a shared array buffer. #34755 (@vincentfretin, @claude)
- KeyframeTrack
  - Fix `shift()` ignoring tangent data. #34951 (@kwy404)
- LatheGeometry
  - Normalize the normal of the last point. #35153 (@spokodev)
- LightProbe
  - Fix JSON round trips. #34859 (@gjija, @Mugen87)
- LightShadow
  - Clean up. #35213 (@Mugen87)
- Line
  - Line, Points: Copy morph targets in `copy()`. #35147 (@Enesuygurs)
- Line3
  - Fix closest point for degenerate segments in `distanceSqToLine3()`. #34673 (@kwy404)
- Math
  - Improve tree-shaking of unused classes. #34619 (@mrdoob)
- MeshPhysicalMaterial
  - Add EON rough diffuse BRDF. #34379 (@Ryan-G7, @Mugen87)
  - Add iridescence thickness min/max properties. #35039 (@Mugen87)
- Object3D
  - Honor pivot when decomposing local matrices. #34811 (@gjija, @mrdoob)
- ObjectLoader
  - Fix loading of BatchedMesh available ids. #34652 (@gjija, @Mugen87)
  - Restore `SpotLight.map`. #35128 (@HEOJUNFO, @claude)
- PMREM
  - Restore minimal roughness, improve roughness ramp. #34645 (@Mugen87)
- PMREMGenerator
  - Replace the CubeUV atlas with cube render targets. #34585 (@mrdoob, @claude)
- RenderContexts
  - Simplify comment. 121e626bb5d58ddd4f1d975010997f73688e665f (@Mugen87)
  - Add the camera type to the state key. #35123 (@arodic, @claude, @sunag)
- Renderer
  - Fix edge cases in `dispose()`. #34765 (@Mugen87)
  - Improve canvas target disposal. #34969 (@Mugen87)
  - Track the source material in override passes. #35232 (@mrdoob)
- Renderers
  - Fix polygon offset with reveresed depth buffer. #34606 (@Mugen87)
  - Preallocate wireframe indices. #34621 (@mrdoob)
  - Fix blit region in `copyTextureToTexture()`. #35167 (@batuhansalkim)
  - Ignore logarithmic depth buffer when reversed depth buffer is enabled. #35276 (@mrdoob, @claude)
- RendererUtils
  - Preserve additional renderer state. #35233 (@kemchenj)
- RenderObject
  - Use `hashArray()` in `getDynamicCacheKey()`. #34553 (@Mugen87)
  - Fix dispose listener for geometries. #34605 (@Mugen87)
  - Detect missing color change for instanced meshes. #34752 (@Mugen87)
  - Add uv `channel` to material cache key. #34773 (@Mugen87)
  - Exclude deprecated `iridescenceThicknessRange`. 2b7c79ef262c5f929d6170ebbdcc7cf2e0ee6742 (@Mugen87)
  - Fix handling of `blending` and `combine`. #35113 (@a411919924, @Mugen87, @claude)
- RenderObjects
  - Improve geometry check. #34799 (@Mugen87)
- RenderTarget
  - Give each attachment its own `TextureSource`. #34970 (@ycw, @Mugen87)
- Shadows
  - Fix point light shadow seams. #35267 (@mrdoob, @Mugen87)
- Skeleton
  - Take ownership of previous data. #34976 (@Mugen87)
- SkinnedMesh
  - Avoid iterator spread in applyBoneTransform(). #34810 (@sarojpahi)
- Sprite
  - Serialize `center`. #35162 (@mkantautas)
- StorageBufferAttribute
  - Add support for disposing storage buffer attributes. #34664 (@gkjohnson)
  - Fix feedback on disposal. #34666 (@gkjohnson, @Mugen87)
- Texture
  - Add `mipmapsAutoUpdate`. #34630 (@Mugen87)
- Textures
  - Return `generation` key in `updateTexture()`. #34659 (@Mugen87)
- TextureSource
  - Never write `undefined` into the target vector in getSize(). #34615 (@madisonrickert, @Mugen87, @claude)
- Triangle
  - Fix `closestPointToPoint()` returning `NaN` when `a` equals `b`. #34695 (@kwy404, @Mugen87)
- WebGLBackend
  - Fix single-layer array render targets. #34510 (@WilliamLiu-1997, @Mugen87)
  - Clear caches in `dispose()`. #34602 (@Mugen87)
  - Improve `dispose()`. #34688 (@Mugen87)
  - Fix clear() with a disabled color write mask. #34729 (@drakeo338, @Mugen87)
  - Fix FloatType depth textures with MSAA. #34768 (@WilliamLiu-1997)
  - Fix MSAA with default depth textures. #34927 (@WilliamLiu-1997)
  - Use correct depth texture for clear. #34928 (@Mugen87)
  - Move `transforms` and `attributes` to `ComputePipeline`. #35009 (@Mugen87)
- WebGLProgram
  - Remove unreachable shader chunk alias fallback. ce84e0dbeb795869ec6876599c184df4a294d5c1 (@mrdoob)
- WebGLPrograms
  - Remove undefined morphAttributeCount cache-key field. eb955c1ef3bd7d421c4ed237887b75456dc047e1 (@mrdoob)
  - Fix material.precision leaking into other materials. #34818 (@mrdoob)
- WebGLRenderer
  - Only apply pixel ratio to the canvas in setViewport() and setScissor(). #34460 (@mrdoob, @claude)
  - Support `FrustumArray`. #34275 (@Mugen87)
  - Improve geometry disposal. #34529 (@Mugen87)
  - Improve texture disposal. #34530 (@Mugen87)
  - Reuse binding points for uniform groups. #34669 (@gkjohnson)
  - Align shadow camera layer handling to `WebGPURenderer`. #34670 (@Mugen87)
  - Correctly init default depth textures. #34687 (@Mugen87)
  - Add `getProgramVariant()`. #34739 (@Mugen87)
  - Support `needsDepthTexture` in `setEffects()`. #34858 (@mrdoob)
  - Fix PCF shadow bias with reversed depth. #34892 (@WilliamLiu-1997)
  - Move` frame` increament before project. #35103 (@Mugen87)
  - Fix color morphing regression. #35140 (@Mugen87)
  - Fix instanced attributes viewing a buffer attribute. #35227 (@sunag)
- WebGLState
  - Reset blending cache in `setMRTBlending()`. #34990 (@yujiaxu-ops, @Mugen87, @claude)
- WebGLTextures
  - Fix point light shadow disposal. #34522 (@Mugen87)
  - Don't invalidate depth for `DRAW_FRAMEBUFFER`. #35155 (@Mugen87)
- WebGLTextureUtils
  - Fix `copyTextureToBuffer()` with red, RG and integer formats. #34852 (@mrdoob)
  - Fix source layer detection in `copyTextureToTexture()`. #35111 (@HEOJUNFO, @claude)
- WebGLUniformsGroups
  - Fix uniforms with array values. #34889 (@mrdoob)
  - Fix std140 layout of arrays of uniforms. #34890 (@mrdoob)
- WebGPUBackend
  - Skip generateMipmaps when the framebuffer copy dest has no mip chain. #34582 (@204a)
  - Fix widening of `uint16` indices in standard use case. #34734 (@cmhhelgeson, @Mugen87)
  - Fix ArrayCamera depth clear value with reversed depth. #34804 (@mrdoob, @claude)
  - Recreate array camera layer descriptors when the depth texture changes. #34850 (@mrdoob)
  - Fix `copyFramebufferToTexture()` outside of render passes. #35133 (@mrdoob, @Mugen87)
- WebGPUBindingUtils
  - Select depth aspect for sampled depth textures. #34584 (@WilliamLiu-1997)
- WebGPURenderer
  - Fix render target texture dispose crash. #34496 (@Mugen87)
  - Textures never removes dispose listeners. #34368 (@wcandillon, @Mugen87, @claude)
  - Align `dispose()` for geometries. #34516 (@Mugen87)
  - Ensure valid state in `compileAsync()`. #34506 (@Mugen87)
  - Properly delete shader programs. #34601 (@Mugen87)
  - Refactor node attribute disposal. #34603 (@Mugen87)
  - Improve VAO caching and disposal. #34610 (@Mugen87)
  - Replace "addLight" with "lightNode" reference. #34622 (@gkjohnson)
  - Unify handling of interleaved attributes. #34690 (@Mugen87)
  - Derive `viewport` and `stencil` flags from render context. #34692 (@Mugen87)
  - Introduce `ProxyNodeMaterial`. #34684 (@sunag)
  - Refactor render cache key. #34726 (@Mugen87)
  - Reset `timestampWrites` with disabled `trackTimestamp`. #34760 (@Mugen87)
  - Add missing `DEPTH32F_STENCIL8`, fix default depth texture. #34803 (@Mugen87)
  - Support depth-only render targets. #34782 (@mrdoob, @Mugen87, @claude)
  - Release previous pipeline and programs when switching to cached ones. #34821 (@mrdoob)
  - Add `_updateDispatchSize()`. #34871 (@Mugen87)
  - Clear texture update ranges after upload. #34919 (@MikeFernandez-Pro, @Mugen87)
  - Throw an error if "count" and "dispatchSize" are used together. #34813 (@gkjohnson, @sunag)
  - Fix `scissorTest` check. #35000 (@Mugen87)
  - Always bind struct storage buffers as arrays. #34807 (@gkjohnson)
  - Compile pipelines in parallel in `compileAsync()`. #34816 (@sunag)
  - Fix shader reuse for instanced meshes. #34872 (@EdoardoLuciani, @mrdoob, @sunag)
  - Preserve material side in `compileAsync()`. #35016 (@mrdoob)
  - Share node builds across call depths. #35014 (@mrdoob, @Mugen87)
  - Support `dispose()` for all buffer attributes. #34685 (@sunag)
  - Support uncompressed data in compressed textures. #35082 (@arodic, @Mugen87, @claude)
  - Support `CompressedCubeTexture`. #35083 (@arodic, @Mugen87, @claude)
  - Share builds between instanced meshes with `referenceAttribute()`. #35007 (@mrdoob, @sunag)
  - Fix output camera initialization when starting in XR. #35126 (@salmanmkc, @Mugen87)
  - Fix disposed geometries with static objects and bundles. #35105 (@sunag, @Mugen87)
  - Fixed disposed PMREM. #35185 (@Mugen87)
  - Cull ArrayCamera draws per sub-camera. #35164 (@bhouston, @Mugen87, @claude)
  - Merge consecutive `BatchedMesh` draws that share a geometry range. #35259 (@MikeFernandez-Pro, @Mugen87)
  - Rename `ProxyNodeMaterial` -> `NodeMaterialInstance`. #35269 (@sunag)
  - Start the internal animation loop on first use. #35278 (@mrdoob, @claude)
  - Don't start the animation loop in `setAnimationLoop( null )`. #35279 (@mrdoob, @claude)
- WebGPUTextureUtils
  - Fix getColorBuffer() cache check. #34826 (@mrdoob)
  - Fix row padding in `copyTextureToBuffer()`. #34851 (@mrdoob)
- WebXRController
  - Use quaternion when decomposing pose matrices. #34817 (@mrdoob)

**Nodes**

- Nodes
  - Make build more efficient. #34531 (@Mugen87)
  - Unify temporary node caching in `Node`. #34607 (@sunag)
  - Use named MathUtils imports. #34625 (@mrdoob)
  - Delegate variable statements to NodeBuilder. #34617 (@sunag)
  - Fix `lightViewPosition()` with ArrayCamera. #34912 (@bhouston, @claude)
- AttributeNode
  - Allow the context to provide attribute values. #35054 (@sunag)
- BasicEnvironmentNode
  - Limit env map rotation to `envNode`. #34570 (@Mugen87)
- Batch
  - Only update the previous matrices texture when the matrices change. #35057 (@HEOJUNFO, @Mugen87, @claude)
  - Recreate the previous matrices texture when the instance count changes. #35075 (@HEOJUNFO, @Mugen87, @claude)
- BitcountNode
  - Return the input type for zero in the WebGL fallback. #35217 (@HEOJUNFO, @claude)
- BumpMapNode
  - Add `normalNode` parameter. #35101 (@MikeFernandez-Pro)
- Camera
  - Isolate ArrayCamera uniforms across shader builders. #34916 (@bhouston)
- ClippingNode
  - Fix clipping with ArrayCamera. #35096 (@bhouston, @Mugen87)
- EnvironmentNode
  - Resolve environment textures before rendering. #35036 (@sunag)
- getParallaxCorrectNormal
  - Keep axis-aligned directions finite. #35049 (@bhouston, @Mugen87)
- GLSLNodeBuilder
  - Fix buffer name collisions between stages. #35012 (@mrdoob)
  - Fix `generateTextureLevel()` with depth textures. #35136 (@Mugen87)
  - Fix uniform block lookups in shared bind groups. #35222 (@mrdoob, @claude)
- LightProbeNode
  - Update light probe uniforms in the render group. #35060 (@arodic, @claude)
- LightsNode
  - Honor light version for shadow casting lights. #34949 (@Mugen87)
  - Fix cache key of shadow casting lights before the first build. #35019 (@mrdoob)
- MaterialNode
  - Fix clearcoat roughness texture channel. #34564 (@hybridherbst)
- Node
  - Cache node overrides per context. #35050 (@sunag)
- NodeBuilder
  - Move shared bind groups cache into Bindings. #34707 (@Mugen87)
  - Remove `getSharedDataFromNode()`. #34857 (@mrdoob)
- NodeMangager
  - Fix stack trace in async builds. #34727 (@Mugen87)
- NodeMaterial
  - Fix `copy()`. #34766 (@Mugen87)
  - Add `emissiveNode` to lambert, phong and toon materials. #35059 (@MikeFernandez-Pro)
- NodeMaterialObserver
  - Force full refresh when the output target changes. #34968 (@arodic)
  - Force full refresh with custom fog and environment nodes. #34996 (@arodic)
  - Clean up. c5e5061ed040ff74cef33b96bf84ef16f7282998 (@Mugen87)
  - Add missing material properties. #35022 (@Mugen87)
  - Track texture uv transforms. #35062 (@arodic, @Mugen87, @claude)
  - Improve output target ceck. #35156 (@Mugen87)
  - Revert `fogNode` and `environmentNode` tracking. #35221 (@Mugen87)
- NodeSampler
  - Fix `clone()`. #35094 (@Mugen87)
- NodeStorageBuffer
  - Fix stale attribute references. #34939 (@WilliamLiu-1997)
- NodeUniformBuffer
  - Fix stale attribute references. #34941 (@Mugen87)
- NodeUtils
  - Add `mergeContext()` to merge override nodes of nested contexts. #35108 (@sunag)
- OverrideContextNode
  - Add `shaderStage` parameter to `overrideNodes()`. #35109 (@sunag)
- PassNode
  - Compile with the render configuration in `compileAsync()`. #35168 (@sunag)
- PhysicalLightingModel
  - Fix specular intensity in direct lighting. #34764 (@EdoardoLuciani)
- PointShadowNode
  - Adhere CubeCamera conventions. #34899 (@Mugen87)
  - Loop over shadow filter taps. #35186 (@bhouston)
- RangeNode
  - Use `hash()` instead of per-object buffers. #34897 (@mrdoob)
  - Make random values independent of node creation order. #34920 (@sunag, @mrdoob)
- RectAreaLightNode
  - Fix lighting with ArrayCamera. #35095 (@bhouston, @Mugen87)
- ReflectorNode
  - Fix reflection with view offset. #34917 (@scottcampbelldata)
  - Fix `bounces: false` with multiple cameras. #34977 (@arodic)
- RenderOutputNode
  - Make `premultipliedAlpha` optional. #34948 (@Mugen87)
- RTTNode
  - Keep the renderer's clear color. #34855 (@HEOJUNFO, @Mugen87, @claude)
- ShadowBaseNode
  - Remove unused velocity flag. #34854 (@mrdoob)
- ShadowFilterNode
  - WebGLRenderer, WebGPURenderer: Fix PCF radius for non-square shadow maps. #35018 (@mrdoob)
  - Create the PCF shadow uniforms once per shadow. #35047 (@sunag)
- ShadowNode
  - Render shadows with needsUpdate only once. #34794 (@mrdoob, @claude)
  - Fix shadows with reverse depth in first frame. #34801 (@Mugen87)
  - Update shadows at least once. #35093 (@Mugen87)
  - Avoid redundant scene matrix updates. #35203 (@mrdoob)
- SpriteNodeMaterial
  - Use the center of the rendered sprite. #35064 (@arodic, @claude)
- StorageBufferNode
  - Better support `mat2` with WebGL. #34595 (@Mugen87)
- TextureNode
  - Simplify and optimize uniforms. #34552 (@Mugen87)
  - Propagate comparison sampling to the shared binding. #34555 (@dswhy, @Mugen87)
  - Detect filter and type changes. #34556 (@Mugen87)
  - Allow for non-mergeable uniforms. #34450 (@Mirei3D)
  - Fix int/float arithmetic regression. #34898 (@Mugen87)
  - Add `getTextureGradient()` context to provide analytic uv gradients. #35121 (@sunag)
- ToneMappingFunctions
  - Fix ACES Filmic fit denominator. #35110 (@HEOJUNFO, @claude)
- TSL
  - Fix `attributeArray()` buffer count usage. #34591 (@Mugen87)
  - Fix scalar constant caching. #34618 (@mrdoob)
  - Enable caching for reused type conversions. #34633 (@sunag)
  - Use local declarations for cached values and variable intents. #34637 (@sunag)
  - Share and vectorize bicubic filter calculations. #34655 (@mrdoob)
  - Share dielectric scattering in indirect lighting. #34656 (@mrdoob, @Mugen87)
  - Fix per-component `select()`. #34425 (@bhouston, @sunag)
  - Fix scope and reuse of function calls containing loops. #34643 (@sunag)
  - Share EON directional albedo in indirect lighting. #34660 (@mrdoob, @Mugen87)
  - Add type promotion in operators and math functions. #33695 (@shotamatsuda, @sunag)
  - Fix getViewPosition() with WebGL reversed depth. #34724 (@WilliamLiu-1997)
  - Add function layout to IBLSheenBRDF. #34824 (@mrdoob, @claude)
  - Simplify function layouts and add layouts to pure functions. #34843 (@sunag)
  - Optimize function layouts with include deduplication and default parameters. #34848 (@sunag)
  - Make nodes their own variable intents and improve build performance. #34815 (@sunag)
  - Fix external variables being generated twice when used in a branch. #35067 (@sunag)
  - Add color morphing. #35141 (@Mugen87, @sunag)
  - Fix parameter length of `quadBroadcast()`. #35218 (@HEOJUNFO, @Mugen87, @claude)
  - Build `before()` nodes only in the setup stage. #35245 (@sunag)
- TSLCore
  - Move the swizzle cache to a `WeakMap`. #35251 (@sunag)
- UniformArrayNode
  - Fix `mat2` usage in WebGL. #34587 (@Mugen87)
- ViewportDepthNode
  - Rename `getProjectionDepth()` to `projectionDepth()`. #35230 (@Mugen87)
- WGSLNodeBuilder
  - Add Directives to Fragment Stage and Update NodeBuilder. #34513 (@cmhhelgeson, @Mugen87)
  - Support `gather()` with multisampled textures. #34609 (@RenaudRohlinger, @claude)
  - Honor read-write storage textures in the fragment stage. #34923 (@HEOJUNFO, @Mugen87, @claude)
  - Fix `grad()` with unfilterable textures. #35169 (@sunag)

**Addons**

- Addons
  - Avoid unnecessary regex backtracking. #35184 (@mrdoob)
- 3DMLoader
  - Fix authentication and custom header forwarding to internal asset loaders. #35024 (@bhouston)
- BitonicSort
  - Dispatch a complete sort in one compute pass. #35275 (@subashc2023)
- BufferGeometryUtils
  - Validate morph attributes in mergeGeometries(). #34532 (@cuishuang)
  - Support interleaved data in `mergeVertices()`. #34665 (@Mugen87)
  - Match tangent precision to quantized normals in `computeMikkTSpaceTangents()`. #34714 (@mrdoob, @Mugen87, @claude)
  - Fix `deinterleaveGeometry()` with morph attributes. #34827 (@MikeFernandez-Pro)
  - Add `remapAttribute()`. #34945 (@bhouston)
  - Preserve `morphTargetsRelative` in `mergeGeometries()`. #35177 (@HEOJUNFO, @Mugen87)
  - Fix group count of Infinity in mergeGroups(). #35258 (@shan3520, @Mugen87)
- CCDIKSolver
  - Improve clamp. #35023 (@Mugen87)
- ClusteredLighting
  - Add spot lights and WebGL2 fallback support. #34978 (@sunag)
- ColladaLoader
  - Fix n-gon attribute triangulation. #34862 (@gjija, @Mugen87)
  - Fix sRGB to linear conversion of vertex colors. #35129 (@HEOJUNFO, @claude)
- ColorConverter
  - Fix HSV conversion at black and white boundaries. #34806 (@dhairyajangir)
- CSMShader
  - Sync `lights_fragment_begin` with the core chunk. #35248 (@subashc2023)
- DDSLoader
  - Align data length computation to DirectXTex. #34908 (@Mugen87)
- DRACOLoader
  - Fix loop bound when repacking unaligned attributes. #35037 (@cherenkov, @claude)
- EXRExporter
  - Fix zip partial block. #34964 (@richardmonette)
  - Add RLE compression. #34972 (@richardmonette)
  - Add PIZ compression. #34979 (@richardmonette)
  - Add textureIndex option for MRT render targets. #35207 (@repalash)
- EXRLoader
  - Remove duplicate half-float decoder. #34574 (@bhouston)
  - Use lookup table for DWA linear conversion. #34573 (@bhouston)
- GCodeLoader
  - Fix extrusion detection in relative mode. #34895 (@scottcampbelldata, @Mugen87)
  - Fix parsing of files with CRLF line endings. #35171 (@L4XB, @Mugen87)
- GLTFExporter
  - Fix orthographic camera xmag and ymag. #35215 (@HEOJUNFO, @Mugen87, @claude)
- GLTFLoader
  - Fix GLTF loader credential forwarding to buffers and bitmap textures. #35025 (@bhouston)
  - Parse embedded KTX2 images without a Blob. #35193 (@Construkted-Reality, @Mugen87, @claude)
- GTAOPass
  - Remove combined depth and normal texture support. #34836 (@bhouston, @Mugen87)
  - Fix external buffer handling. #34831 (@bhouston)
- IESLoader
  - Apply photometric factors linearly instead of squaring candela. #34554 (@dswhy)
  - IESLoader, IESSpotLight: Add support for 2D & symmetric profiles. #34626 (@gkjohnson)
- Inspector
  - Remove Circular Dependency. #34592 (@cmhhelgeson)
  - Fix CPU time double counting and FPS with skipped frames. #35070 (@sunag)
  - Fix number input drag interfering with text selection. #35117 (@MikeFernandez-Pro)
  - Truncate long parameter labels. #35206 (@MikeFernandez-Pro)
  - Fix overdraw render mode. #35255 (@sunag)
  - Fix mini panel checkbox and collapsed folder spacing. #35252 (@sunag)
  - Fix color grading exports and add example. #35257 (@sunag)
  - Fix GPU time display and triangle count for indirect draws. #35256 (@sunag)
- JXLLoader
  - Add native HDR image loading. #35015 (@bhouston, @Mugen87)
- KTXLoader
  - Fix mipmap size read. #34905 (@Mugen87)
  - Correctly round down mips. #34906 (@Mugen87)
- LDrawLoader
  - Optimize smoothNormals() by fixing quadratic time complexity. #35200 (@AvaLovelace1)
  - Fix null conditional edge material for unknown colours. #35219 (@3a632062, @claude)
- LightMapper
  - Diffuse light baker, works with Light Probe and VXGI. #34991 (@bhouston)
  - Clean up demo, add VGXI gather function. #35183 (@Mugen87)
- LightProbeGrid
  - Batch probe capture with ArrayCamera for ~4x faster bakes. #34909 (@bhouston, @claude)
  - Project SH in row blocks. #35150 (@bhouston, @claude)
  - Faster multi-bounce (and default examples to use multi-bounce). #35145 (@bhouston, @Mugen87)
  - Place probes at the center of their cells. #35265 (@mrdoob)
  - Only sample the last grid that contains the fragment. #34798 (@mrdoob, @Mugen87, @claude)
- LightProbeGridWebGL
  - Extend from `Light`. #34744 (@Mugen87)
- LineMaterial
  - Fix world-unit extrusion with orthographic cameras. #34540 (@diarmidmackenzie, @Mugen87)
  - Fix depth shifting. #35139 (@Mugen87)
- Loaders
  - Add priority and HTTP cache controls. #34936 (@bhouston, @Mugen87)
- Lut
  - Read the end colors of a color map in linear space. #35181 (@L4XB, @Mugen87)
- LUT3dlLoader
  - Prevent invalid bit depth values. #34903 (@Mugen87)
- LUTCubeLoader
  - Fix domain regex. #34900 (@Mugen87)
- MaterialXDocument
  - Clean MaterialX loader + compiler. #34523 (@bhouston)
  - MaterialXLoader bug fix: Support handlers that resolve with a Texture. #34575 (@bhouston, @Mugen87)
  - MaterialXLoader bug fix: consistent and correct nodedef defaults. #34593 (@bhouston)
- MaterialXLoader
  - Only resolve loading promises when all sub-resources are loaded. #34439 (@bhouston)
  - Support displacement nodes (both scalar and vector). #34576 (@bhouston)
  - Match output-less `separate2/3/4` behaviour with MaterialX. #34835 (@hybridherbst)
  - Add `setNodeResolver()`. #34832 (@hybridherbst)
  - Support `hsvadjust`, `facingratio` and `triplanarprojection`. #34986 (@hybridherbst)
  - Support `surface_unlit`. #34987 (@hybridherbst)
  - Support nodes implemented by node graphs. #34988 (@hybridherbst)
